wallpapers.name: Ribbons

wallpapers.name: Prism
wallpapers.description: Bold diagonal shards of light with sharp edges and glass-like gradients.

wallpapers.name: Orbs
wallpapers.description: Large overlapping rounded forms with crisp rims, lit from the top left.

wallpapers.name: Aurora
wallpapers.description: Curtains of light over a night or dawn sky, above layered ridges with lit edges.

wallpapers.name: Dunes
wallpapers.description: Layered dunes at sunset, or dusk in the dark print, each crest a crisp lit line.

wallpapers.name: Bloom
wallpapers.description: A fan of petals opening from the lower left, each a crisp-edged gradient leaf.

wallpapers.name: Pool

wallpapers.name: Facets
